messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Discovery Group Team,

Your mining-focused executive search work is closely aligned with my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across mining, resources and energy where responsible development, regulatory discipline and institutional trust are central to execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
